text: {"components": [{"type": "entity", "quote": "The Nuclear Safety Commission", "gist": "The Nuclear Safety Commission (NSC)"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Federal Council", "gist": "Federal Council"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Federal Department of the Environment, Transport, Energy and Communications (DETEC)", "gist": "DETEC"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Federal Nuclear Safety Inspectorate (FNSI)", "gist": "FNSI"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The NSC advises the Federal Council, the Federal Department of the Environment, Transport, Energy and Communications (DETEC) and the Federal Nuclear Safety Inspectorate (FNSI) on matters relating to the safety of nuclear facilities.", "gist": "NSC advises DETEC, Federal Council, and FNSI on nuclear facility safety matters"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "five to seven", "gist": "5 to 7"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Article 71 of the Swiss Federal Nuclear Energy Act (SR 732.1)", "gist": "Article 71 of Swiss Federal Nuclear Energy Act"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Ordinance on the Nuclear Safety Commission (NSC Ordinance, SR 732.16)", "gist": "NSC Ordinance"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The NSC is a permanent administrative commission, which comprises five to seven part-time members who are specialists in areas of science and technology that are of importance to nuclear safety.", "gist": "NSC is a permanent administrative commission with 5-7 part-time specialist members for nuclear safety"}]}
